name: RassyClaw
author: OpenClaw
description: Run RassyClaw (OpenClaw) with Ollama for local LLM + embeddings and LocalAI as an OpenAI-compatible provider.

form_fields.label: RassyClaw Gateway Token
form_fields.hint: Required token for Control UI and WebSocket auth.

form_fields.label: Ollama Base URL
form_fields.hint: Native Ollama chat endpoint, no /v1 suffix (example: http://ollama:11434).

form_fields.label: Ollama API Key
form_fields.hint: Any non-empty value works for local Ollama (example: ollama-local).

form_fields.label: Ollama Model ID
form_fields.hint: Model id to register in the OpenClaw catalog so it shows up even if discovery times out.

form_fields.label: Ollama Model Name
form_fields.hint: Display name for the Ollama model catalog entry.

form_fields.label: Ollama Context Window
form_fields.hint: Context window for the Ollama model entry.

form_fields.label: Ollama Max Tokens
form_fields.hint: Max output tokens for the Ollama model entry.

form_fields.label: Ollama Embedding Base URL
form_fields.hint: Optional separate Ollama endpoint for embeddings when chat and embedding models run on different ports or hosts.

form_fields.label: Ollama Embedding Model
form_fields.hint: Embedding model used by memory search with Ollama.

form_fields.label: LocalAI Base URL
form_fields.hint: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (example: http://localai:8080/v1). Use a proxy URL if your backend rejects Authorization headers.

form_fields.label: LocalAI API Key
form_fields.hint: API key for LocalAI if your endpoint requires auth.

form_fields.label: LocalAI Model ID
form_fields.hint: Model id exposed by LocalAI (without provider prefix).

form_fields.label: LocalAI Model Name
form_fields.hint: Display name for the LocalAI model catalog entry in OpenClaw.

form_fields.label: LocalAI Context Window
form_fields.hint: Context window for the LocalAI model entry.

form_fields.label: LocalAI Max Tokens
form_fields.hint: Max output tokens for the LocalAI model entry.

form_fields.label: Primary Model Ref
form_fields.hint: Default model for sessions. Defaulting to a smaller LocalAI model avoids the gpt-oss Ollama crash path seen in live testing.

form_fields.label: Fallback Model Ref
form_fields.hint: Optional fallback model ref. Leave blank to disable fallback.
